## Installation

1. Download and install the [GTA III Widescreen Fix](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#gta3) - it includes the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader) - or install the ASI Loader on its own.
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for GTA III](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/gta3/GTA3.XboxRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` and `.ini` files into the `scripts` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- The water and the blood the game spawns as particles leave drops on the camera as well, see `BloodDrops` in the ini.
- The ini is watched while the game runs, so its settings can be changed and tested without restarting.
